## Facts about existing herds

- Colorado State University, [Record relocation: CSU, partners provide 39 Laramie Foothills bison to 3 Native Nations](https://newsmediarelations.colostate.edu/2022/04/11/record-relocation-csu-partners-provide-39-laramie-foothills-bison-to-3-native-nations/) (April 2022): herd history since 2015, partners, CSU's research role, and transfers to Tribal Nations.
- Denverite, [Denver donates 30 bison to Tribal Nations](https://denverite.com/2023/03/15/denver-donates-30-bison-to-tribal-nations/) (March 2023): Denver's herds and its Tribal donation program since 2021.
- World Wildlife Fund, [Rosebud Sioux Tribe to create North America's largest Native-owned and managed bison herd](https://www.worldwildlife.org/news/press-releases/rosebud-sioux-tribe-to-create-north-americas-largest-native-owned-and-managed-bison-herd/) (May 2020): Wolakota's size, ownership, and capacity.
- Wikipedia, [Wolakota Buffalo Range](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wolakota_Buffalo_Range): sources of Wolakota's buffalo, including Rocky Mountain Arsenal.
- University of Colorado Boulder, [Center for Native American and Indigenous Studies](https://www.colorado.edu/cnais/).

## Map data

```{python}
#| output: asis
status = {"ok": "Retrieved", "failed": "Not retrieved", "demo": "Preview data"}
d = show.MANIFEST.get("datasets", {}).get("rap")
if d:
    src = f"[{d['source']}]({d['url']})" if d.get("url", "").startswith("http") else d["source"]
    print(f"| Data | Source | Last built (UTC) | Status | Notes |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n"
          f"| Grassland cover | {src} | {d['retrieved_utc']} | {status.get(d['status'], d['status'])} | {d.get('note','')} |")
```

Herd locations on the maps are approximate and are placed only for orientation.

## About this site

This is a discussion resource prepared from public information. It is not a proposal from CU Boulder, any Tribal Nation, or any land manager, and it speaks for none of them.
